tools rather than shelling out to curl. bounded-systems/.github's

project-scoped .mcp.json is discovered from the project directory, which never
This is the HOSTED surface (worker/index.js, served at /mcp). It does NOT verify
the bytes it returns against the site's Sigstore-signed manifest — every result
says so in _meta.verification, with the digest and the manifest URL so a caller
can check independently. For verified reads use @bounded-systems/site-mcp, which
runs locally and checks each artifact before returning it.
Why the hosted one is declared here rather than the verifying one: site-mcp's
published version is 0.2.0, which predates the one-verb-per-subject shape
(site-mcp#26). Until that is released, npx would install the older three-verb
surface whose get_conformance returns the whole 19.7 KB report. Swap this entry
for the stdio server once a release carries the folded verbs.
